labels.scope: Only the reduction step of the printed proof (« On se ramène à une décomposition de w en somme de convexes contenus dans des variétés distinguées simples »). The equivalence balayable/homogène is T-bz-c3-balayable-somme-cor; the planner's evidence says this lemma marks nothing alone.
questions: « les sous-variétés distinguées simples de chaque v_i » (the Corollary's reduction, l.629-630) are read for v_i inside its own support L_i: the simple distinguished subspaces of the closed cone (L i).subtype ⁻¹' closure (kPrime (v i)) in ↥(L i), pushed into E. Read in E they would be wrong (a summand that does not span E has every subspace of a complement of L_i among its distinguished subspaces; argued, not formalized). The transport to a sphere S(↥L_i) / S(k_i) is not in this file.

instances: Benzecri.SimplesSommeInstance.simplexO_estSommeS_edges, edges_subset, iSupIndep_Lp: the open 3-simplex of S(3) is the sum (Déf. 5) of its open edges s(Q01), s(Q23) with R^4 = <e0,e1> ⊕ <e2,e3>; with simplexO_hyps every hypothesis of simplesS_somme is a Lean term; simplexO_simplesS_somme is the conclusion, simplexO_simplesS_somme_ncard the four simple ones split between the planes
Benzecri.cube_simples_isSommeConvexes: [-1,1]^n = ([-1,1]^n ∩ R^S) + ([-1,1]^n ∩ R^{S^c}), every hypothesis of the affine simples_isSommeConvexes discharged
kb_proposals: Distinguished subspaces inside one half P of a conjugate pair (P,Q) of W are exactly those of P ∩ W read in ↥P (estDistingue_map_iff / estSimple_map_iff in Chapter3/SimplesSomme.lean); needs no convexity, and the conjugates correspond by C ↦ C ∩ P and C' ↦ C' ⊔ Q (modular law).

For a Déf. 5 sum w = Σ v_i, partial sums Σ_{j∈S} y_j of a decomposition lie in the closed cone closure (kPrime w) (sum_subset_mem_closure_kPrime, via mem_closure_kPrime_of_add); this makes every projection on a summand preserve K̄(w).
Supports of Déf. 1 summands which are nonempty convex positive cones are independent: span C = C − C (exists_sub_of_mem_span_cone) plus iSupIndep_of_injOn.
